mapper.select: SELECT A.CAL_NM, A.CAL_TITLE, A.CAL_CONTENT, A.CAL_START, A.CAL_END, A.TEXT_COLOR, A.BG_COLOR, A.USER_NO, A.CALENDAR_TY, A.FILE_GROUP_NO, A.CAL_STATUS, A.CAL_REG_DATE, A.READER_NO, W.USER_NM AS READER_NM, A.CAL_CNT, U.USER_NM FROM CALENDAR A JOIN TB_USER U ON A.USER_NO = U.USER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_USER W ON A.READER_NO = W.USER_NO WHERE A.CALENDAR_TY = 1 AND A.CAL_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY A.CAL_NM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar ( cal_nm, cal_title, cal_content, cal_start, cal_end, text_color, bg_color, user_no, reader_no, calendar_ty ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(cal_nm), 0) + 1 FROM calendar), #{calTitle}, #{calContent}, #{calStart}, #{calEnd}, #{textColor}, #{bgColor}, #{userNo}, #{readerNo}, 1 )

insert into calendar (CAL_NM, CAL_TITLE, CAL_CONTENT,CAL_START, CAL_END,USER_NO, CALENDAR_TY, CAL_REG_DATE, READER_NO) values((select nvl(max(cal_nm),0)+1 from calendar), #{calTitle}, #{calContent}, #{calStart}, #{calEnd}, #{userNo}, 1, SYSDATE, #{readerNo})
